cases.why: A definition answer is where a confident near-miss hides best: swap which methods are idempotent and the prose still reads perfectly. The default path has to get this right. Phase 21.5 corrected this case's label from general to technical: two models independently read PUT/DELETE idempotency and idempotency keys as technical content, which is evidence about the LABEL rather than about the models -- it was simply wrong. Its general-stratum coverage moved with it; general-summary, general-explains-a-concept and general-how-a-mechanism-works continue to hold the default path for the summary, concept and mechanism shapes.
